@friendsAccept.description: Button that accepts a received friend request.

@friendsAcceptRequestLabel.description: Accessibility label of the add icon on a suggestion when that user already sent a request.

@friendsAdd.description: Main button on the profile of someone who is not a friend yet: sends a friend request.

@friendsBlock.description: Menu item and confirm button that block a user.

friendsBlockConfirm: Are you sure you want to block this user?

@friendsErrorLoadUsers.description: Shown instead of the suggestions on Add Friends when the search fails; tapping it retries.

friendsFollowed: Following! You'll get notifications about their capsules

@friendsHideSuggestionLabel.description: Accessibility label of the cross that hides a suggested friend.

@friendsMyProfile.description: Main button when the opened profile is the user's own.

@friendsPending.description: Main button on a profile the user already sent a friend request to.

friendsQrHint: Point your camera at the QR code to add a friend
friendsQrInvalid: Invalid QR code. Please scan a Later profile QR code.

@friendsReject.description: Button that rejects a received friend request.

@friendsRemoveAction.description: Confirm button of the remove-friend dialog.

friendsRemoveConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove user from friends?

@friendsReport.description: Menu item that reports a user.

@friendsRequestAlreadyExists.description: Toast when the user taps add on someone they already sent a request to.

friendsRequestReceivedInfo: This user sent you a friend request
friendsRequestsEmptySubtitle:
When someone sends you a friend request,
it will appear here

@friendsRequestsReceivedTab.description: Toggle on Friend Requests: requests other people sent to the user.

@friendsRequestsSentTab.description: Toggle on Friend Requests: requests the user sent.

@friendsSearchHint.description: Search hint on My friends (searches only among the user's friends). Keep it short.

@friendsSendRequestLabel.description: Accessibility label of the add icon on a suggested friend.

friendsSentEmptySubtitle:
Friend requests you send
will appear here
friendsSuggestionRemoved: Suggested friend removed from the list!

@friendsViewProfile.description: Main button on the profile of someone who is already a friend: opens their friend profile.

friendsMutualCount: {count, plural, =1{1 mutual friend} other{{count} mutual friends}}

@friendsMutualCount.description: After the @username of a suggested person.

friendsFindByUsernameHint: Search by @username or scan a friend's QR code. People your friends know show up here.

@friendsSearchPeopleHint.description: Hint of the people search on Add friends (by name or username).

@friendsFromContacts.description: Add friends: look for friends among the phone's contacts (opt-in).

friendsFromContactsExplain: Later reads the email addresses in your contacts on this phone and sends only scrambled fingerprints of them. You see the people who chose to be found; nothing from your contacts is kept. Once an hour.

@friendsFromContactsExplain.description: Explains what the contacts look-up sends and keeps, before it starts.

@friendsFromContactsGo.description: Button that starts the contacts look-up.

friendsFromContactsNone: None of your contacts can be found on Later yet

@friendsFromContactsNone.description: No one from the contacts was found.

friendsFromContactsTooSoon: You looked a moment ago. Try again in an hour.

@friendsFromContactsTooSoon.description: The look-up runs once an hour.

friendsFromContactsDenied: Later needs access to your contacts for this
friendsFromContactsFailed: Could not look for friends now

@friendsPinnedOnProfile.description: Small label above the row of pinned friends on My friends (shown in capitals).

@friendsEdit.description: Text button next to the pinned friends label: opens the Pin a friend sheet.

@friendsCount.description: How many friends the user has, at the end of My friends.

@friendsMoreFor.description: Screen reader label of the three dots button on a friend's row.

@friendsPinSheetTitle.description: Title of the sheet where the user chooses the friends pinned to their profile.

@friendsPinSheetCount.description: Under the Pin to your profile title: how many friends are pinned of the most allowed.

@friendsPinSheetSearch.description: Hint of the search field in the Pin to your profile sheet.

@friendsDone.description: Closes the Pin to your profile sheet and saves the pins.

@friendsShareCardTile.description: Tile on Add friends: opens the user's own shareable card (profile link and QR code).

@friendsScanTile.description: Tile on Add friends: opens the QR code scanner.

@friendsRequestsTab.description: Tab on Add friends with the friend requests the user received, and how many.

@friendsSuggestedTab.description: Tab on Add friends with people the user may know.

@friendsAskedToBeFriend.description: Small label above the received friend requests (shown in capitals).

@friendsSentByYou.description: Small label above the friend requests the user sent (shown in capitals).

@friendsPeopleYouMayKnow.description: Small label above the suggested people (shown in capitals).

@friendsSearchResults.description: Small label above the people found by the search on Add friends (shown in capitals).

@friendsAddPlus.description: Small button on a suggested person: sends them a friend request.

@friendsRequested.description: Shown instead of + Add when the user already sent a friend request.

friendsNoRequestsHint: When someone asks to be your friend, it shows up here

@friendsNoRequestsHint.description: Under 'No friend requests' on the Requests tab of Add friends.

@friendsPinToProfile.description: Row in a friend's menu: pins the friend at the top of the user's profile friends.

@friendsUnpinFromProfile.description: Row in a friend's menu when the friend is pinned.

@friendsShareTheirCard.description: Row in a friend's menu: shares the friend's profile link. The name is the friend's first name.

@friendsFollowRow.description: Row with a switch in a friend's menu: following the friend (notifications about their capsules). The name is the friend's first name.

@friendsRemoveFriend.description: Row in a friend's menu: asks to confirm, then removes the friend.

@friendsFollowing.description: State of the follow button when the user already follows this friend.
